name: Portable Shop Cabin
description:
Portable Shop Cabin — Ready-to-Sell Structures for Shops and Kiosks

You need a shopfront fast. Renting permanent space is expensive and construction takes months. A portable shop cabin is a factory-built retail unit — display window, rolling shutter, counter shelf — delivered to your site in 7 days and ready to trade from immediately. If you run a kiosk, retail outlet, or temporary store, this is the cabin you are looking for.

A shop you can move — not a fixed shopfront

A SAMAN portable shop cabin is a complete retail unit built in our factory and delivered ready to trade — then lifted and moved again when your location changes. The welded mild-steel frame, corrugated MS skin and integrated lifting lugs let a crane pick the whole shopfront cleanly and a flatbed carry it to the next pitch. The shutter, display window and counter travel with the unit, so the shop you set up on day one is the same shop you re-site later — no rebuild, no re-fit.

Choose your shopfront

The front of the unit is what makes it a shop, and you choose how it opens. A roller shutter secures the whole frontage when you close for the day. A sliding display window puts stock and signage on show and serves customers across a counter. Many outlets use both — a shutter for security and a display window for trading. The service counter is fitted at the front working position, with back-of-counter space for stock. Frontage configuration, counter position and opening sizes are finalised to your approved drawing before build.

Size the shop to your frontage and stock

Pick the footprint by how much shopfront and stock space you need, not just floor area. Shorter units give a compact single-counter frontage; longer 30–40 ft units give a wide shopfront with room for display, a serving line and a back store. Wider footprints suit a shop-plus-storeroom split. Every size stays on this one product as an in-page choice — longer units ride a 40 ft open trailer, while 20 ft and under travel on a 20 ft trailer, so the size you pick also decides how the shop moves.

Base, delivery and access — then relocation

Because the cabin is finished before it leaves the factory, placement is quick: prepare a flat, level base; we deliver, offload and position; the shop is usable the same day. Plan the practical steps at both ends — confirm a compacted or paved base, truck and crane access with a clear route to the spot, who handles offloading, and that power and any water points can be connected. When you relocate, the process reverses: disconnect services, lift, transport, re-level, reconnect, and re-check that the shutter and display window run true. Choosing a footprint that stays within easy transport width keeps every future move simple.

Price — what the figure includes

Prices are ex-GST for the base specification of each size; 18% GST is added, and shopfront fit-out beyond the standard package and freight to your site are quoted separately. What moves your final number: size, frontage configuration (shutter, display window or both), counter and interior fit-out, electrical and signage provisions, finish level, and delivery distance from our Bangalore (South) or Greater Noida (North) unit. Send your size, frontage choice and location for an itemised quotation.

Delivery and installation across India

Every shop cabin is factory-built and delivered ready to trade, dispatched from Bangalore for South India and Greater Noida for the North. Our team offloads and positions the unit on your prepared base; most units are usable shortly after they land. When you relocate later, we can help arrange the transport.

How this differs from our other cabins

If you need a general relocatable room — office, store or site room — rather than a retail shopfront, see our wider move-and-reuse cabin range. If your shop is going onto an active construction site as part of the site setup, our site-deployed shop unit for construction projects is built for that duty instead. This page is the relocatable retail shop you set up, trade from, and move to the next pitch.

Why buy from SAMAN

We manufacture in-house at our own Bangalore and Greater Noida units — you deal with the maker, not a reseller. SAMAN POS India Private Limited is ISO 9001:2015, ISO 14001:2015 and ISO 45001:2018 certified, NSIC-enlisted, DPIIT (Startup India) recognised, Udyam-registered and GST-registered, with 500+ projects delivered across India. Structural warranty is 5–10 years, confirmed at quotation.

Contacts: South — +91 88616 22859 / sales@samanportable.com · North — +91 87960 39938 / ncr@samanportable.com

Questions Shop Owners Ask

Which shopfront can I have — roller shutter, display window, or both?

All three. A roller shutter secures the full frontage when you close; a sliding aluminium display window shows stock and serves across the counter; many outlets fit both. The frontage configuration and opening sizes are set to your approved drawing before we build.

Can the service counter and display opening be customised?

Yes. The counter position, working side and the size and placement of the front opening are finalised on the approved drawing to suit how you serve customers and display stock.

What base do I need before the shop cabin arrives?

A flat, level, load-bearing surface — compacted ground, a concrete apron or a simple plinth. No deep foundation is required. Re-check level every time the unit is re-sited.

What truck and crane access is needed for delivery and a later move?

Room for a delivery truck (20 ft or 40 ft trailer depending on the shop length) and, where used, a crane to lift the unit onto its base and off again. Confirm route width and overhead clearance for both placement and future relocation.

How is the shop cabin lifted and re-sited without rebuilding it?

A crane lifts the complete unit by its integrated MS lifting lugs onto a flatbed; at the new pitch it is offloaded, positioned on a prepared level base and re-levelled. Services are disconnected before the move and reconnected after — the shutter, display window and counter stay in place.

Can two shop units be joined side by side for a larger retail floor?

Yes. Units can be placed together to create a wider shopfront or a shop-plus-store layout; the joining detail is planned on the approved drawing so each unit still lifts and moves individually.
